description: The graph illustrates the training loss over iterations for various models, including Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), and SepLLM variants with different configurations (n=64, n=64, H, n=64, H/T, and n=128). The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000, while the y-axis shows the loss value, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. All models exhibit a steep initial decrease in loss, with the Vanilla model showing the highest initial loss. The SepLLM variants, particularly SepLLM (n=128), demonstrate a more rapid convergence and lower final loss compared to the other models. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) and SepLLM (n=64, H) models also show improved performance over the standard SepLLM (n=64). The StrmLLM (n=64) model performs comparably to the SepLLM variants but with slightly higher loss values. Overall, the SepLLM models, especially with larger n values, achieve better performance in terms of loss reduction.
